pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pApplies an upward movement impulse using FE.$p$(l)Use$()$pCharge the module or carrying calculator, then use it. Velocity and cooldown are server settings. An empty battery cannot perform the jump.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:calculators/installing)Using modules inside a Flawless Calculator$()$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pObtain this module: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.
